title: Cleopatra Lived Closer To The Moon Landing Than The Pyramids
description:
The Great Pyramid of Giza was built around 2600 BC. Cleopatra ruled Egypt from 51 to 30 BC, more than 2,500 years later. The Moon landing happened in 1969, only about 2,000 years after her death. So Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid.

Sources: Wikipedia, 'Great Pyramid of Giza' (built around 2600 BC), 'Cleopatra' (reign 51-30 BC), 'Apollo 11' (1969). The year gaps are our own arithmetic.

What other timeline blew your mind? Tell us in the comments.
